---
title: "Config"
---

The `config` block contains table-level metadata used for validation and rendering.

## Fields

| Field                        | Type    | Default   | Description                      |
|------------------------------|---------|-----------|----------------------------------|
| `table_cols`                 | integer | —         | Number of columns (required)     |
| `header_rows`                | integer | —         | Number of header rows (required) |
| `body_rows`                  | integer | —         | Number of body data rows (required) |
| `stub_cols`                  | integer | 0         | Number of stub columns           |
| `row_striping`               | boolean | false     | Enable alternating row colors    |
| `row_striping_include_stub`  | boolean | false     | Include stub in striping         |
| `row_striping_include_body`  | boolean | false     | Include body in striping         |
| `column_labels_hidden`       | boolean | false     | Hide column header row           |
| `table_width`                | string? | null      | CSS-like width value             |
| `container_width`            | string? | null      | Container width                  |
| `container_height`           | string? | null      | Container height                 |
| `container_overflow`         | string? | null      | Overflow behavior                |
| `locale`                     | string  | "en-US"   | Locale identifier                |
| `page_break_mode`            | string  | "avoid"   | `"avoid"`, `"allow"`, `"force-between-groups"` |
| `aria_label`                 | string? | null      | Accessibility label              |
| `aria_describedby`           | string? | null      | Accessibility description ref    |
| `summary`                    | string? | null      | Table summary / caption          |

## Example

```json
{
  "config": {
    "table_cols": 5,
    "header_rows": 2,
    "body_rows": 10,
    "stub_cols": 1,
    "row_striping": true,
    "row_striping_include_stub": true,
    "row_striping_include_body": true,
    "column_labels_hidden": false,
    "table_width": "100%",
    "container_width": "900px",
    "locale": "en-US",
    "page_break_mode": "avoid"
  }
}
```

::: {.callout-note}
`body_rows` counts **data rows only** — summary rows are not included.
Stub columns must be contiguous starting from column 0.
:::
